breakpoints.note: The raw saved file ends with `@includedir \"` at EOF; `sudoers_input()` appends the missing newline before lexing, after which the lexer returns `INCLUDEDIR` and switches to `GOTINC` to read the following path token. The earlier syntax errors reported for unrelated lines do not stop the parser from reaching this final directive.

First project-side materialization of the attacker-controlled include path on the crashing path. After `sudoers_input()` normalizes the unterminated final line, the `GOTINC` lexer rule consumes the raw token `\"` and stores it as `sudoerslval.string` for the parser.

For the witnessed one-byte string `"`, this block advances `opath` to the terminating NUL and underflows `olen` from 1 to `(size_t)-1`. The fix changes this exact logic to `if (olen > 1 && opath[0] == '"' && opath[olen - 1] == '"')` and returns `NULL` when the post-strip length is zero.
